zh-CN.title: 城市气泡卡片升级
items: 语音、文件与位置统一采用城市信息卡设计
四座城市的卡片完整继承主题材质与色彩
发送中效果改为沿气泡边框流动的环带

en.title: Upgraded city bubble cards
items: Audio, file, and location messages now share a city information-card design
Every card fully inherits its city's material and color language
Sending feedback now travels around the bubble border
